mechanicalTests: 4 PASS; 800–1600 samples including two cycles world-contact planting
browserTests: 64 distinct frames; eight directions; normal/quarter; stepping; gameplay-size; mobile PASS

benchmarkComparison.NPCWalking: Separate left/right contact and arm counter-motion read through a consistent torso silhouette. Our cycle preserves these distinctions without importing poses or art.
benchmarkComparison.FemaleNovice: Extended support, folded clearing foot and returning heel distinguish consecutive phases. Our eight-phase side/diagonal proof demonstrates these; frame counts and cadence were chosen independently.
benchmarkComparison.limits: A neutral rig does not establish painted-layer quality. Colour assists limb identification; final painted overlap and silhouette must be rechecked.

visualInspection: Inspected all eight phase renders in S/SW/W/NW/N/NE/E/SE, continuous contact diagram, browser sampled motion normal/quarter, and gameplay-size captures.
criticalFailure: Both knees stayed ahead of the hip throughout the cycle; rearward thigh extension was inadequate despite planted-foot math.
